row.title: A supply checked twice
row.body: The pair appears to have been checked together, while the place for a date was left blank.
row.rival_reading: A routine stock check can pair these objects, and an omitted date says nothing about why they were stored.
row.gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
